            "Basketball": ["Play 4", "Play 5", "Play 6"],
            "Soccer": ["Play 7", "Play 8", "Play 9"]
        }

        # Create a menu for users to select a play or formation
        self.menu = tk.Menu(self.root)
        self.root.config(menu=self.menu)

        # Create a file menu for saving and sharing game plans
        self.file_menu = tk.Menu(self.menu)
        self.menu.add_cascade(label="File", menu=self.file_menu)
        self.file_menu.add_command(label="Save Game Plan")
        self.file_menu.add_command(label="Share Game Plan")

    def run(self):
        self.root.mainloop()

if __name__ == "__main__":
